description: A native German man of about fifty. He speaks clear standard German as his mother tongue, with no English or American accent. A low, slightly gravelly chest voice, unhurried and solid. Annoyed at first, then patiently explanatory - a man who stops to teach you the rule rather than shout about it. Plain and matter-of-fact. Not gruff, not booming, not a radio announcer.
texte: Sie laufen auf dem Radweg! Der rote Streifen ist fuer Fahrraeder. Der graue ist fuer Sie. Und an der Ampel warten Sie. Auch ohne Auto.
